theme: incident log content search GREPFILES + LOGALL multi-file stamp

weaknesses.title: GREP filters bag field text; GREPFILES filters file content — easy mix-up
weaknesses.detail: SYS GREP bag ERROR matches path strings containing ERROR (usually none). SYS GREPFILES reads files. Agents using GREP for log content search silently get empty bags.
weaknesses.repro: GREP path_bag ERROR → empty; GREPFILES path_bag ERROR → hits

weaknesses.title: GREPFILES case-sensitive by default; Error ≠ ERROR
weaknesses.detail: Severity tokens often mixed case. Must remember GREPFILESI. Same class as GREP vs GREPI string ops.
weaknesses.repro: GREPFILES bag ERROR misses gamma Error three

weaknesses.title: APPENDALL is string SUFFIXALL — not multi-file append
weaknesses.detail: LOGALL/APPENDFILES is the path-bag stamp. APPENDALL appends a suffix string to every bag *field text*. Wrong op = silent no file IO.
weaknesses.repro: APPENDALL bag -suf → field text change only

weaknesses.title: LOGALL creates missing paths (no create-off mode)
weaknesses.detail: Useful for markers but dangerous if path bag has typos — invents junk files. No LOGALL existing-only / fail-on-miss.

weaknesses.title: No multi-needle GREPFILES OR (ERROR|FATAL|PANIC)
weaknesses.detail: Need sequential GREPFILES + UNION. GREPANY is bag-field only.
weaknesses.repro: want content any of N needles → multiple greps

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: HITS path bags collapse in JSON.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline on plates
weaknesses.detail: HITS/PATHS last line; LOGALL itself does append NL to logs.

weaknesses.title: GREPFILES is substring not regex
weaknesses.detail: Needle ERROR matches ERRORCODE. No word-boundary mode. Same false-friend class as GREP bag fields.
weaknesses.repro: content ERRORCODE hit by needle ERROR

workarounds: Always GREPFILES for log content; GREP only for path-string bags
Use LOGALL/APPENDFILES never APPENDALL for multi-log stamp
Validate paths exist before LOGALL if create-on-miss unwanted
UNION of GREPFILES results for multi-needle
language_gaps: Rename APPENDALL or document path-vs-string more loudly
